## Level-Up Flow

**Trigger:** XP thresholds in `XP_THRESHOLDS` (`worker/src/types/index.ts:175`) — 300/900/2700/6500/14000/23000/34000/48000/64000, max level 10. Worker's `shouldLevelUp(character)` (`services/character.ts:159`) checks `xp >= XP_THRESHOLDS[level] && level < 10`, returned as `canLevelUp` by `POST /api/action` and `POST /api/combat/resolve` (`routes/action.ts:99`, `routes/combat.ts:109`). Frontend also pre-computes it (`character-state.service.ts:52,76`) but the server value wins (`game-console.component.ts:128,155`).

**UI:** Banner on character sheet (`character-sheet.component.html:66`) + ability picker in console sidebar (`game-console.component.html:19-28`); a system message prompts it after combat.

**Call:** `levelUp(key)` (`game-console.component.ts:183`) → `GameApiService.levelUp(sessionId, characterId, abilityChoice)` (`game-api.service.ts:74`) → **`POST /api/levelup`** (`worker/src/routes/levelup.ts:10`). `abilityChoice` must be str/dex/con/int/wis/cha; 400s if `!shouldLevelUp`.

**Character changes** (`services/character.ts:133` `levelUp`):
- Level +1
- HP gain = `roll(class hit die) + CON mod`, added to both `max_hp` and current HP (hit dice: Fighter/Ranger d10, Rogue/Cleric/Bard d8, Wizard d6)
- Chosen ability score +2 (uncapped, AC unchanged)

Response also includes flavor text (`generateLevelUpNarrative`), a `system` log `[Level Up] …`, and a DM history turn. Frontend then does `setCharacter`, `setCanLevelUp(false)`, shows a message, updates campaign slot level. Only one level per call.
